company.name: Deep Instinct
company.shortDescription: Deep Instinct applies deep learning to cybersecurity, offering zero-day attack protection.
company.description:
Deep Instinct applies artificial intelligence’s deep learning to cybersecurity. Leveraging deep learning’s predictive capabilities, Deep Instinct’s on-device solution protects against zero-day threats and APT attacks with unmatched accuracy. Deep Instinct safeguards the enterprise’s endpoints and/or any mobile devices against any threat, on any infrastructure, whether or not connected to the network or to the Internet. By applying deep learning technology to cybersecurity, enterprises can now gain unmatched protection against unknown and evasive cyber-attacks from any source. Deep Instinct brings a completely new approach to cybersecurity enabling cyber-attacks to be identified and blocked in real-time before any harm can occur.

Deep Instinct USA is headquartered in San Francisco, California and Deep Instinct Israel is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.

productsAndServices.description: A prevention-first cybersecurity platform that uses deep learning to block known, unknown, zero-day, ransomware, and AI-generated threats across cloud storage, NAS, applications, and endpoints.
productsAndServices.name: Deep Instinct Data Security X (DSX)

productsAndServices.description: A generative AI threat-analysis engine that explains blocked zero-day and unknown attacks in real time and provides security teams with actionable context for prevention and response.
productsAndServices.name: DSX Companion (DIANNA)

productsAndServices.description: Implementation and lifecycle services that help customers deploy, operate, optimize, and obtain measurable value from Deep Instinct’s prevention-first security platform.
productsAndServices.name: Deep Instinct Customer Success and Deployment Services

productsAndServices.description: Online technical and sales training that teaches customers, partners, and administrators how to configure, deploy, monitor, investigate, and support Deep Instinct solutions.

aiResearchSummary.text: Deep Instinct focuses on enhancing cybersecurity through deep learning techniques. Their research includes developing methods and systems for detecting malicious webpages. This involves training detectors using samples of both malicious and non-malicious webpages, extracting text content from the source code, and refining detection capabilities. Their R&D efforts aim to bolster defenses against zero-day attacks.
